channel.title: Books on Pods
channel.description: Conversations about books and plays, old and new. Two hosts read the best passages and discuss their impressions as well as what critics and scholars have said about them.
channel.itunes:summary: Conversations about books and plays, old and new. Two hosts read the best passages and discuss their impressions as well as what critics and scholars have said about them.
channel.itunes:author: BooksonPods

item.title: Love's Labour's Lost 1. The Oath and the Arrival
item.description: Act 1 Scene 1 and Act 2. The academy oath, Berowne's resistance, the Princess's arrival, and the first battle of wits.

item.title: Love's Labour's Lost 2. Below Stairs
item.description: Act 1 Scene 2 and Act 3. Armado, Moth, Costard and Jaquenetta, the remuneration joke, and Berowne's 'And I, forsooth, in love!'

item.title: Love's Labour's Lost 3. Letters Gone Astray
item.description: Act 4 Scenes 1 and 2. The Princess's hunt, Armado's letter read aloud, Holofernes and Nathaniel, and Berowne's sonnet on its way to the king.

item.title: Love's Labour's Lost 9. The Whole Play
item.description: The whole play, ending included: from Theobald, Johnson and Hazlitt's dismissals to Pater, Carroll and Bloom, the feminist and historical readings, the School of Night, Love's Labour's Won, the stage history, and why the play still matters.

item.title: Julius Caesar Full Play 0. Cast list
